messages.text: Rehan sends message to England with ton and five-for in Lions win

metadata.summary: Rehan Ahmed served the England selectors a reminder of his all-round talents by hitting a hundred and taking five-for in the Lions' fourth unofficial ODI win over West Indies A.
metadata.content: England Lions: Rehan Ahmed hits hundred and takes five-for in 80-run win over West Indies A | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content England Lions: Rehan Ahmed hits hundred and takes five-for in 80-run win over West Indies A Rehan Ahmed (108 off 100 balls) struck 11 fours and five sixes at No 3, before claiming 5-60 with his leg spin in the 80-run win; the Lions have won all seven of their matches on tour so far, following a 3-0 sweep in the T20 series by leading 4-0 in the five-match ODI leg Sunday 15 November 2026 09:10, UK Image: Rehan Ahmed reminded the England selectors of his talents with a terrific all-round display for the Lions in the West Indies Rehan Ahmed served the England selectors a reminder of his all-round talents by hitting a hundred and taking five-for in the Lions' fourth unofficial ODI win over West Indies A. Rehan (108 off 100 balls) struck 11 fours and five sixes at No 3 as the Lions - who had already clinched the series, leading 3-0 - posted 330 after winning the toss in St Kitts. The all-rounder then claimed 5-60 with his leg spin as the tourists bowled their opponents out for 250 overs in reply. The 22-year-old has played five Test matches, 11 ODIs and 14 T20s for England since making his debut as an 18-year-old in 2022.
